cs.th: Ask HN: Best current model routers for OpenWRT, DD-WRT, Tomato, etc.?

cs.t: Eero works okay but the consistency is not great (wild variations in ping time, for instance). I switched to a Ubiquiti (Unifi) setup and it is a world of difference. My ping times are super stable (like < 1ms of standard deviation awesome) and that makes a big difference for any realtime demands.
cs.th: Wi-Fi startup Eero lays off 30 employees

cs.t: News to me. dslreports reported a C for bufferbloat. My router (eero) has a "labs" section that had SQM disabled. After enabling, dslreports is reporting an A.
cs.th: What Can I Do About Bufferbloat?

cs.t: I like the idea of running OpenWRT. I did it for years. I eventually grew tired of being my own Network admin. The risk of bricking my router, and having to review what felt like arcane update rules before every upgrade process made me finally cave and just get an Eero. I don't love the lack of features, and I really don't like Amazon owning the company, but it works for me.
